test_title: PYST 19: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 08 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

When my calculations are wrong, I have __to pore over__ the spreadsheet to find the error.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'** i.e.** 'No improvement'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined part **"I have to pore over"** is already correct in this context.
 
• **"Pore over" **is the correct phrasal verb meaning to study or examine something closely.
 
• Other given options distort the meaning or create grammatical errors.
 
• Since the sentence is already correct, no improvement is needed.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is:* 'When my calculations are wrong, I have to pore over the spreadsheet to find the error.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **To poring over** - Incorrect form of the verb and improper usage.
 
• **To pore by **- Incorrect preposition; "by" does not fit with "pore."
 
• **To pored over **- Incorrect tense of the verb "pore."
